SELECT f.sale_date, count(distinct s.store_id) stores, count(*) n, round(sum(f.net_amount)) net, min(f.etl_loaded_at) mn, max(f.etl_loaded_at) mx
FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key WHERE f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-29' AND DATE '2026-10-04' AND s.store_id<>999 GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

WITH s AS (
  SELECT sum(f.net_amount) AS amt FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store d ON d.store_key = f.store_key
  WHERE f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-09-01' AND DATE '2026-09-30' AND d.store_id <> 999),
r AS (
  SELECT sum(x.refund_net) AS amt FROM fact_return_line x JOIN dim_store d ON d.store_key = x.store_key
  WHERE x.return_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-09-01' AND DATE '2026-09-30' AND d.store_id <> 999)
SELECT round(s.amt - r.amt, 2) AS net_sales_eur, s.amt gross_before, r.amt ret FROM s, r
